name: Anna Reticle
source:
The representative of the mayor and all vampires of Aqua Eden. She came to the island city at the request of Sayo to work as her assistant. She and Sayo have earned the respect of all vampires on the island.

A fan of the Hiyodori-goe no Saka-otoshi position
